notes: C1 is directly captured by P5 (and partly P16), which notes that coherence reaches ~0.5 while the pump is still on so the pump can imprint the phase, and suggests a shorter pump pulse so condensation occurs after pump-off. C8 asks for continuous phase traces across pump turn-off (0.9 to 1.28 us), while P4 asks for continuous phase-uniformity statistics across pump turn-off to catch brief phase locking missed by the three snapshots and P16 asks to fit continuous single-shot phase trajectories back to onset (marked 'partly'). C5 (sign/origin of the frequency shift near 1 us) is marked 'partly' under P1, which challenges the inconsistent explanations of the downward shift and asks for a quantitative estimate from f = gamma(B - mu0*M_s).
